title: Efficient LLM Moderation with Multi-Layer Latent Prototypes

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the misclassification rate of the proposed Multi-Layer Prototype Moderator (MLPM) on harmful prompts specifically labeled under the 'Social Stereotypes And Unfair Discrimination' category within the WildGuardMix dataset.

bias_targets.target: Hate Speech and Toxicity (including Racism and Sexism)
bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the detection performance (F1 score and misclassification rates) of the moderation tool on prompts designed to elicit toxic, racist, or sexist responses using safety benchmarks like Aegis, ToxicChat, and WildGuardMix.
